mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism and acetaminophen may compete for glucuronidation pathways while mefloquine can induce CYP3A4, potentially affecting acetaminophen clearance and increasing hepatotoxicity risk with chronic use.
action: Monitor for signs of hepatotoxicity; use acetaminophen at lowest effective dose and duration; consider alternative antipyretics if chronic dosing anticipated during mefloquine therapy.
